risks.risk: The exact unit being sold is still unclear (photo shows multiple engines/assemblies).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo where the seller clearly marks the exact engine (e.g., with a handwritten tag) and shows readable engine/serial/engine code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine/assembly with possible missing parts and uncertain condition.

risks.risk: Working condition remains unproven remotely despite the seller’s claim.
risks.proof: Request a short video (with audio) of the engine starting and idling, or a compression test/diagnostic printout.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed working (worst case: needs overhaul/doesn’t run).

risks.risk: “No knock” cannot be confirmed without audio while running.
risks.proof: Audio video during idle and light revs showing no knocking sounds.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential internal wear (worst case: knock/noise possible).

risks.risk: “Low mileage” cannot be verified without a mileage/ECU/odometer reading.
risks.proof: Photo of odometer/ECU mileage screen or service record showing mileage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown mileage (worst case: higher mileage).

risks.risk: “Never opened” cannot be verified without seal/fastener inspection photos.
risks.proof: Close-ups of gasket/seal areas and fasteners (head cover/crankcase covers) showing no tampering.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk (engine may not match the buyer’s application).
risks.proof: Request the exact make/model/year it fits plus the engine code/part number from a readable label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain compatibility (worst case: buyer needs extra parts).

proof_requests: Send new clear photos identifying the exact engine being sold (handwritten tag + multiple angles) and a readable engine/serial/engine code plate.
Send a short start-and-idle video with audio (showing no knock).
Send a photo of mileage/ECU/odometer reading or service record.
Send close-ups of seals/gaskets/fasteners to support “never opened.”
State the exact vehicle/bike application (make/model/year) and provide the engine code/part number for fitment.
response.reason: The seller’s text claim of testing cannot replace physical proof. With no new photos/video or readable identification, the exact unit, working condition, mileage, and “never opened” status remain unverified, so a safe worst-case price still can’t be set.
